movelist.name: Quiver Dance
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by +1 Combat Stage each.

movelist.name: Rage
movelist.effect: The user becomes Enraged. Until the end of the user’s next turn, if the user is Enraged, the user gains +1 Attack Combat Stage whenever they are damaged by an Damaging Move or Attack.

movelist.name: Bug Buzz
movelist.range: Cone 2 or Close Blast 2, Sonic, Smite
movelist.effect: Bug Buzz lowers the Special Defense of all targets on 19+.

movelist.name: Giga Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Whirlwind
movelist.effect: All targets are pushed X meters, where X is 8 minus their weight class. If the Line targets into a Smokescreen, the smoke is dispersed. All hazards in the Whirlwind are destroyed.

movelist.name: Attract
movelist.effect: Attract Infatuates the target if its gender is the opposite of the user’s. Attract fails when used by or against Genderless targets.

abilities.name: Pride
abilities.effect: While suffering from Burn, Poison, Paralysis, Freezing, or while Asleep, the user’s Special Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. If suffering from none of these conditions, the user loses any Combat Stages gained this way.

abilities.name: Rivalry
abilities.effect: Whenever the user deals direct damage to a target of the same gender, increase the Damage dealt by +5.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Grass-Type attacks. If the user is hit by a Grass-Type attack, they gain +1 CS in their choice of Attack or Special Attack. Defensive.
